story_title: OpenAI Introduces Aardvark: Autonomous AI Security Researcher
caption:
OpenAI has officially unveiled Aardvark—an agentic AI security researcher engineered to autonomously identify, validate, and help repair software vulnerabilities at scale.

While conventional scanning tools highlight potential code flaws, agentic systems like Aardvark actively verify exploits and assist in writing fixes. The system is currently in private beta with early sign-ups open.

How do you see agentic AI changing software security?
